articles.title: The restaking gold rush is over, and top protocols are barely making a profit
articles.snippet: As restaking yields dried up and smart-contract risks mounted, Ethereum's top liquid restaking protocol walked away from its core business to build a crypto neobank instead.

articles.title: AI agents could drain cheap bank deposits, Apollo's Torsten Slok warns
articles.snippet: AI agents could trigger a bank run by automatically moving household cash from low-interest checking accounts to higher-yield alternatives, Slok warns.

articles.title: Chainlink launches new version of its crypto bridge tech 'CCIP' to give apps more control over their security
articles.snippet: The new software lets companies add custom security checks so they do not fall victim to the same type of vulnerabilities that plagued rival bridges.

articles.title: Traders aren't panicking yet despite cooling crypto sentiment
Crypto-friendly institution Franklin Templeton brings its tokenized collateral service to Bybit
articles.snippet: Franklin Templeton’s tokenized money market shares can be used as collateral for USDT or USDC trading credit lines on Bybit while earning yield on the underlying assets.
